column2: The District Secretary/ Government Agent shall have the power to authorize any public officer in writing to
exercise any power vested in him and carry out any function assigned to him under this regulation.

1.
The District Secretary/ Government Agent shall have the power to regulate vehicular traffic or walking to or
from or within the camp area.

2.
No person shall act contrary to any lawful order given by any police officer in compliance with the  instructions
issued to such police officer by the District Secretary/ Government Agent for the exercise of  powers vested
in him under the Para (1) of this regulation.
